description: A man in a tattered, sleeveless off-white tunic runs barefoot down a dusty, rocky hillside path, one arm thrown up and a strained expression on his face, kicking up dust. Behind him on the left, a walled hilltop citadel with classical-looking buildings sits across a distant plain under a dark, stormy sky with a warm light break near the horizon. There is no visible text, border, or frame; the painting fills the whole image in a dark oil style.
